Job Summary 
Seeking a highly skilled and versatile Full Stack Developer to build end-to-end solutions from initial design through deployment and optimization. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise across modern backend and frontend technologies, with experience in cloud-based development, data-driven solutions, and emerging AI/ML technologies. The role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and the ability to contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle. 
 Key Responsibilities 
•    Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET Core/.NET Framework and Angular. 
•    Build and consume RESTful APIs and backend services. 
•    Develop responsive and user-friendly front-end interfaces. 
•    Architect and deploy applications in Microsoft Azure using cloud-native services such as App Services. 
•    Design, develop, and optimize SQL and Azure SQL databases, including performance tuning and query optimization. 
•    Collaborate with product, QA, DevOps, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions. 
•    Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and ongoing support. 
•    Contribute to data-driven solutions, including analytics, reporting, and data pipelines. 
•    Explore and integrate AI/ML capabilities into applications where applicable. 
•    Ensure code quality through established development best practices, code reviews, and testing. 
•    Troubleshoot application and technical issues and implement effective solutions. 
•    Manage development priorities and deliver solutions independently and collaboratively. 
 Required Qualifications 
•    Strong experience with .NET Core and/or .NET Framework. 
•    Hands-on experience building modern applications with Angular v16 or later. 
•    Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices. 
•    Solid experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services, particularly Azure App Services. 
•    Strong proficiency in SQL and Azure SQL, including database design and performance tuning. 
•    Proven experience working as a Full Stack Developer across frontend and backend technologies. 
•    Experience with version control systems such as Git. 
•    Experience working with CI/CD pipelines. 
•    Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail. 
•    Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
•    Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams. 
•    Ability to adapt to new technologies and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
•    Self-motivated with the ability to manage priorities and deliver results independently and as part of a team.
